verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a financial-account product, but the evidence documents no export or account-closure capability. The Transaction object API, which can be used to reconcile against internal systems, is only a developer building block for constructing an export. It is not a first-party export of all data in open formats, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
